name: mvp-saas-ventilacoes
description: SaaS multi-tenant de site e gestão para prestadores de climatização (Fase A)

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @vs/shared build && pnpm --filter @vs/db build && pnpm --filter @vs/ui build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:api & pnpm run dev:web
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @vs/shared build && pnpm --filter @vs/db build && pnpm --filter @vs/api start:dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @vs/shared build && pnpm --filter @vs/ui build && pnpm --filter @vs/web dev
